head: codex/5876-recovery-state-machine
title: [v0.92][WP-04.14] Quorum-bound relocation recovery
body:
Implements bounded, durable relocation recovery from majority-committed authority evidence.

- selects one verified committed prefix and fails closed on zero or divergent histories
- journals recovery intent before cleanup, rollback, fencing, activation, and owner commit side effects
- reconciles restart and crash windows with bounded state, time, and durable input reads
- covers pre-fence rollback, post-activation re-fencing, safety windows, replay, capacity, path hardening, and oversized durable inputs

Validation: focused recovery suite 12/12; strict Clippy; deep exact-revision receipt with 21 machine-derived cases; independent exact-head review approved.

Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5876
